source: ESPN public injury report and game summaries

injuries.name: CJ McCollum
injuries.short_comment: McCollum (calf) will miss at least four weeks, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.
injuries.long_comment: The veteran combo guard has been diagnosed with a left calf strain, and he's in line to miss the next month or so. Once rookie first-rounder Kingston Flemings (back) is healthy, he'll have a long runway as Atlanta's top point guard. Aaron Wiggins remains worth holding in nearly all fantasy leagues as well.

injuries.name: Jock Landale
injuries.short_comment: Landale (hip) won't play Sunday against the Pistons.
injuries.long_comment: This will be Landale's fourth consecutive game on the inactive list. His next chance to play will come Friday in Boston.

injuries.name: Mouhamed Gueye
injuries.short_comment: Gueye (foot) is ready to begin on-court activities and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
injuries.long_comment: The team stated in July that the big man would remain sidelined for the next 3-to-4 months after undergoing surgery to repair a fractured left foot, and he's continuing to make progress in his rehab. A timetable for Gueye's 2026-27 debut has yet to be established, thought a date could come into focus following his next evaluation in mid-December.

injuries.name: Asa Newell
injuries.short_comment: Newell underwent surgery Tuesday for a plantar plate tear in his left great toe, and he will be re-evaluated in approximately four months, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
injuries.long_comment: Newell suffered the toe injury in the Nov. 4 win over Washington and is now set to miss an extended period. With Mouhamed Gueye (foot) expected to miss at least three more weeks, Aaron Wiggins and Corey Kispert could see a slight bump in minutes moving forward.

injuries.name: Henri Veesaar
injuries.short_comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.
injuries.long_comment: Veesaar suffered the injury during a workout on Sept. 15, and an MRI confirmed the diagnosis. The No. 52 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft, Veesaar was expected to spend a lot of time with Atlanta's G League affiliate this season.

injuries.name: Kingston Flemings
injuries.short_comment: Flemings (back) is questionable to play Sunday against the Pistons.
injuries.long_comment: Flemings has missed the past three games, but it looks like there's a chance he could return Sunday. If he's cleared to play, Aaron Wiggins would likely head back to the second unit.

injuries.name: Taurean Prince
injuries.short_comment: Prince (knee) underwent surgery to address lingering issues and has no timeline for a return, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.
injuries.long_comment: With Detroit still without a return timetable for Prince after right knee surgery, he appears set for an extended absence well beyond Friday's tilt against Toronto. Prince hasn't been a significant part of the Pistons' rotation this season, so his continued absence is unlikely to create a major fantasy ripple effect.

injuries.name: Duncan Robinson
injuries.short_comment: Robinson will be re-evaluated in one week due to a left quadriceps strain, Coty M. Davis of The Detroit News reports.
injuries.long_comment: Robinson has gotten off to a strong start this season, though he's now expected to miss at least the next week after appearing in each of Detroit's first 12 regular-season games. The sharpshooter is averaging 17.4 points in 30.5 minutes per contest, and his absence will open up additional minutes for Kevin Huerter and Javonte Green.

injuries.name: Cade Cunningham
injuries.short_comment: Cunningham (knee) is probable to play Sunday in Atlanta.
injuries.long_comment: Cunningham is dealing with some minor soreness in his right knee, but he's planning to play through it. Cunningham is averaging 25.6 points, 5.1 rebounds, 7.9 assists, 2.0 triples, 1.4 steals and 0.9 blocks per game this season.

injuries.name: Jalen Duren
injuries.short_comment: Duren (hamstring) has begun on-court activity and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.
injuries.long_comment: Duren is progressing in his rehab after suffering a right hamstring strain Oct. 23, though he'll remain on the inactive list for at least the next two weeks while ramping up toward a return to game action. Paul Reed should continue to play a sizable role in Duren's stead.

injuries.name: Ronald Holland II
injuries.short_comment: Holland (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Atlanta.
injuries.long_comment: Holland has missed the last three games due to a bone bruise in his left knee. If he remains sidelined versus the Hawks, Isaiah Joe, Chaz Lanier and Javonte Green are candidates for more minutes.

injuries.name: Ugonna Onyenso
injuries.short_comment: Onyenso agreed to a two-way contract with the Pistons on Thursday.
injuries.long_comment: The No. 53 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft, Onyenso appears poised to see run in the G League after putting pen to paper on a two-way deal. He'll likely face an uphill battle to carve out a role in the rotation, so Detroit will presumably allow him to continue his development with Motor City.

injuries.name: Ebuka Okorie
injuries.short_comment: Okorie (oblique) is out for Sunday's game in Atlanta.
injuries.long_comment: This will be Okorie's second straight game on the inactive list due to injury. His next chance to play will come Tuesday in Orlando.
